spec_features.spec_quote: `give_up(reason)` — explicit graceful exit. Its existence matters: it gives the model a clean off-ramp
spec_features.evidence: tools.py:42-55 defines give_up in TOOL_SCHEMAS; dispatch() tools.py:91-93 returns {'terminal':'gave_up'}; harness.py:98 sets terminal_signal and harness.py:102-105 breaks the loop and sets transcript.terminal='gave_up'. End-to-end honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Off-ramp is genuinely dispatched and honored as loop termination.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the clean off-ramp whose (non-)use is itself signal (tools.py:4)

spec_features.spec_quote: `max_turns` (default 25): hard cap. Spirals usually manifest well within this.
spec_features.evidence: config.py:40 max_turns=25; passed run.py:64 -> harness run_episode; harness.py:51 `for turn_idx in range(max_turns)` with else branch harness.py:111 setting terminal='hit_cap'. The loop is actually bounded.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: hard cap on the tool loop (config.py:40)

spec_features.spec_quote: `max_tokens` per completion (default 1024): bounds cost and also bounds how long a single self-critical monologue can get
spec_features.evidence: config.py:41 max_tokens=1024; passed run.py:64 -> harness.py:55 client.complete(max_tokens=...); client.py:106/179 forwards to OpenAI/Anthropic API max_tokens kwarg, enforced by provider per completion.
spec_features.notes: Bounds a single completion length; enforced by the API call each turn.
